_comment: Every field the renderer reads. Copy this into the project folder as brief.json, fill it from roles 1-5, then run scripts/render-brief.mjs against it. Fields prefixed _ are the creative record: the renderer ignores them, but they are why a re-run does not repeat rejected work.
_angle: Six specialist agents beat one general one, because the jobs are different jobs.
_angleWhy: A number that shouldn't work. Repeatable after one hearing.

_hooks.text: One idea in. Finished video out. I never touched it.
_hooks.why: Works muted as a first frame, and the interesting word lands inside the first second.

_hooks.text: The best AI video tool is six worse ones.
_hooks.why: Good contradiction, but needs a beat of explanation to land.

_hooks.text: I deleted my editor and replaced it with six prompts.
_hooks.why: Stakes are clear, but 'deleted my editor' overpromises what this pays off.

_hooks.text: The fifth agent is the one nobody builds.
_hooks.why: Open loop is strong; rejected because the video does not make agent five the point.

_hooks.text: If your AI videos look like everyone else's, you are using one model for six jobs.
_hooks.why: Direct address works, too long for a first frame.

_beats.beat: One model doing six jobs does all six at about 60 percent.
Split it: each role gets one job and a gate it has to pass.
The gate is the part that matters. A bad hook dies before it costs a render.
Payoff: the chain is boring, and boring is why it finishes.

script: One idea in. Finished video out. I never touched it. One model doing six jobs does all six at about sixty percent. So split it up. Each role gets one job, and a gate it has to pass before the next one starts. The gate is the part that matters. A weak hook dies for free, instead of dying after you paid to render it. The chain is boring. Boring is exactly why it finishes.

_shots.shows: terminal, six agent names printing in sequence
one overloaded model vs six lanes

_endCardNote: Exactly two fields, title and year, because that is what buildAss renders: title large at y=880, year smaller under it at y=1010. Not a free lines array. For a non-film video, title is the handle or the call to action and year is the supporting line, or omit year.
